result: Report written to `homework-4.4/run-retry2/workers/TASK-16.md`. Summary: `UpdateUserParam`'s missing `@NotBlank`/duplicate-check annotations relative to `RegisterParam` are intentional (partial-update semantics, not a gap) since duplicate-checking is instead enforced via `UpdateUserConstraint`/`UpdateUserValidator` at the command level (`UserService.java:60-107`). The real finding is that the "blank field = leave unchanged" contract — actually implemented in `core/user/User.java:29-49` via `Util.isEmpty` checks — is undocumented anywhere on `UpdateUserParam.java` itself or its consumers (`CurrentUserApi.java`, `UserService.java`), making it discoverable only by reading three layers deep. Also flagged a pre-existing, shared gap: no `@Size` upper bounds on any string field in either DTO, notably `password`, which BCrypt silently truncates past 72 bytes.
